preparation: One common source backbone for all four full483 sequences; deterministic FASPR sidechain packing for every sequence including WT.

repacking.name: FASPR
repacking.build: existing /usr/bin/g++15.2.0 -O3; no fast-math; original source unchanged
repacking.target_case: all uppercase, all sidechains repacked including WT
repacking.algorithm: native deterministic backbone-dependent Dunbrack rotamer search

terminal_policy.allowed_additions: only C-terminal OXT at residue483; reject any other missing atom/residue
terminal_policy.existing_heavy_atoms: preserved, full-precision maximum difference acceptance1e-10Angstrom, serialized coordinates exact
terminal_policy.relaxation: no AMBER or physical-forcefield minimization; native FASPR rotamer optimization and PDBFixer OXT-only construction
terminal_policy.soft_builder_internal_motion: PDBFixer may internally minimize/perform limited soft clash escape for the added terminal atom, not an MD endpoint

entropy.atoms: all canonical protein heavy atoms plus terminal OXT; no H/water/ions/ligands
entropy.total: native get_total_entropy(), cross-check math.fsum of all483 native residue entropies

precision: Serialized coordinates0.001Angstrom; predictor outputs retained at native precision.
comparison_basis: New matched static preparation; published TableS4 used MD-prepared structures. No MD-RMSF or experimental temperature inferred.
recovery: Original PDBFixer all-sidechain preparation rejected for severe overlaps. FASPR replacement passes unchanged geometry/completeness checks. Only exact upstream file/ThreadPool ResourceWarnings were classified separately from scientific warnings.
consumer_serial_policy: FASPR serials normalized reversibly; atom names, residue identities and coordinates preserved; exact inverse restoration verified.
assessment_mode: Operator-guided post-selection comparison; independent native scientist selected FASPR recovery.
